build_embedding_encoder_with_sum_pooling: build an EmbeddingEncoder with sum pooling to combine token embeddings along sequence dimension
build_embedding_encoder_with_mean_poolin: build an EmbeddingEncoder with mean pooling to average token embeddings across a sequence
build_embedding_encoder_with_max_pooling: build an EmbeddingEncoder with max pooling to select the strongest token embedding in a sequence
build_embedding_encoder_with_hashing: build an EmbeddingEncoder with use_hash enabled to hash input indices before embedding lookup
review_embedding_encoder_forward: review the EmbeddingEncoder forward method to understand how pooling is applied to embedded tensors
